headline: Norse Atlantic Norwegian Operating Unit Files for Bankruptcy
summary: Long-haul budget carrier Norse Atlantic's Norwegian operating unit has declared bankruptcy, succumbing to soaring fuel costs driven by the war on Iran.
why: Rising jet fuel costs driven by geopolitical conflicts severely compress airline operating margins, posing acute solvency risks for low-cost carriers with heavy exposure to long-haul routes.

impacts.name: Norse Atlantic
impacts.why: The airline's Norwegian operating unit declared bankruptcy due to rising fuel costs.
